name: Combobox
purpose: Search and choose one stable option ID while preserving independent query and selected value state.
description: Searchable single selection backed by Base UI. Selected IDs and search text remain separate. Native form submission uses the selected ID, not the typed query. For remote search, disable filtering and let the host own requests, race handling, result options and loading.

props.name: filterOptions
props.description: Disable local matching when options already contain host-filtered remote results.

props.name: inputValue
props.description: Search text is separate from the selected form value.

props.name: onValueChange
props.type: ((value: string | null, eventDetails: Primitive.Root.ChangeEventDetails) => void) | undefined

props.name: selectedLabel
props.description: Label fallback when a selected remote ID is absent from the current results.

guidance.overview: Search and choose one stable option ID while preserving independent query and selected value state.
usage: Pass selected value/defaultValue and query inputValue/defaultInputValue independently to Base UI; selected value is string or null. A typed query is not a free-form submitted selection.
Pass value, input-value, open and open-completion callbacks without dropping primitive details or cancellation. Delegate list navigation, selection, dismissal and focus to Base UI.

Local matching searches option labels, descriptions and keywords. filterOptions=false delegates the result set to the host. loading announces status and disables current result selection; the component issues no network requests.
Require unique nonempty option IDs. selectedLabel supplies a display fallback when a remote selected ID is absent from the current result list; the underlying selected ID remains unchanged.

Use Field association on the visible input and pass name/form/required/disabled/readOnly to Base UI. Its associated form control submits the selected ID once; the forwarded ref targets the visible input.
accessibility: Supply a visible label or enclosing Field. Placeholder text is not an accessible name.
Keep native semantics and keyboard focus; use Field for host descriptions and useful error feedback.
intent: Own request debouncing, cancellation, races, caching, loading/error recovery and durable selection labels. Keep controlled query and selected value updates separate and inspect callback reasons before issuing requests.
context: Single selection only; use MultiCombobox for multiple values. No free-solo creation or virtualized remote dataset is provided.
No asynchronous fetching, server validation or automatic error recovery. Remote selected labels must remain available through options or selectedLabel.
